question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Foriegn**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling will be **Foreign**.
 
• The word **Foreign **means some other country.

*Example *: I like this **foreign **cuisine.
